compiled_state.title: RED: Add behavioral tests for check-sprint-trailer.sh hook
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Create tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh — behavioral tests asserting check-sprint-trailer.sh rejects commits in sprint mode missing DSO-Story trailer, and passes otherwise. Must FAIL RED when the script does not exist.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: Test case 1 proves trailer-less commit rejected with documented error message
- DD3: Unit tests written and passing (this test file is the unit test suite)

## Test Approach

Given (case 1 — sprint mode, trailer absent): DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1, commit message has no DSO-Story trailer
When: check-sprint-trailer.sh runs
Then: exit code non-zero; stderr contains 'DSO-Story' and the error message text

Given (case 2 — sprint mode, trailer present): DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1, commit message contains 'DSO-Story: My story title'
When: check-sprint-trailer.sh runs
Then: exit code 0

Given (case 3 — non-sprint mode): DSO_SPRINT_MODE unset, commit message has no DSO-Story trailer
When: check-sprint-trailer.sh runs
Then: exit code 0 (no enforcement outside sprint mode)

## Implementation Notes

- Use mktemp to create temp git repos for testing; use trap-based cleanup
- Mock a commit message by writing to a temp file; use GIT_DIR or GIT_INDEX_FILE to point the script at a test git context, OR pass commit message via STDIN if the script supports it — check the implementation spec
- Prefer creating a temp git repo with an actual commit so git interpret-trailers works correctly
- Test file must be named test-check-sprint-trailer.sh (fuzzy-match compatible with check-sprint-trailer.sh)

## File Impact

### Files to Create
- tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Test exists at tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh and is executable
- [ ] Test FAILS RED (exit 1) when plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh absent
- [ ] Test uses source tests/lib/assert.sh helpers
- [ ] 3 test cases present (sprint+no trailer=fail, sprint+trailer=pass, no-sprint=pass)
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_sprint_mode_trailer_absent_rejected] for plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh
  Verify: grep 'test_sprint_mode_trailer_absent_rejected' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] ShellCheck passes with no errors

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
